text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I'm done. This won't even kill time.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ha, ends with an apology, does it? So 
you're choosing to stay a loser.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Then you don't have time to be moping 
around. Reflect on it, and make sure you 
entertain your owner next time.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You're my dog, and nobody else's. Don't 
you dare degrade yourself into a useless 
mutt.
It ended in a disappointing result...
